args.body: Advance the existing SQLITE-QUOTE-INTAKE-RELEASE-CANDIDATE mission under a valid lease. Reuse the verified bilingual preview from SQLITE-PRIVATE-QUOTE-INTAKE-PREVIEW. Check the staged patch against the current site source before applying it. If the source has diverged, carry over only the verified quote-intake change and preserve newer content. Recheck both decoded mail links, manual-copy text, attribution, nonbinding wording and unrelated file hashes. Read back the committed candidate, run a site dry run, and hand the exact digest and evidence to AUDITOR for a separate eligible provider review. Reuse any equivalent candidate or review already recorded. Keep deployment gated and close the preparation mission with a lesson when its evidence is complete.

description: The completed SQLite preview verified both bilingual inquiry links and showed that reversing the patch restores the captured baseline. That supports preparing the release candidate for independent review of its exact digest. The preview is synthetic evidence. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so buyer demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Any paid order still requires an eligible inquiry, compatible collection, and administrative acceptance.
